lines.text: Private buy lets you buy any token on Solana, straight into a brand-new wallet that can't be traced back to you.
lines.say: Private buy lets you buy any token on Solana, straight into a brand new wallet that can't be traced back to you.

lines.text: Ape into a memecoin from your main wallet, and copy-traders and snipers see it instantly.
Paste any token's mint address. Vanish pulls its chart, market cap and liquidity from DexScreener, and warns you when liquidity is thin.
Pick where it goes, or let Vanish create a fresh wallet for you. Save the key, and import it into Phantom whenever you like.
Vanish can send a little Solana along for gas, so you never have to fund the new wallet yourself.
One proof spends your private balance. The relayer buys through Jupiter, and the tokens land straight in the new wallet.
Your minimum is enforced on-chain. If the buy can't fill, your Solana goes to the new wallet instead, still unlinked.
The new wallet's history starts at the Vanish pool. Nothing points back to you.
Vanish private buy. Any token, no trail. vanish.website
